Jen K.: Aurora StreamTool v1 is GA for hosted today. Staged rollout: canary -> regional rollouts -> global in 48h. Please follow the checklist below. :tada:
Diego: Checklist?
Jen K.: 1) Teams opt into canary keys (header X-Redwood-Canary: aurora-205). 2) Run SDK smoke tests (JS/Go/Python). 3) Validate autoBatch behavior. 4) Verify tool schema ("tools" array) and structured outputs. 5) Watch latency dashboards.
Priya: Where's the migration doc?
Lina (docs): https://internal.redwood.dev/docs/aurora-streamtool-migrate — added sample curl + JS usage.
Jen K.: curl example:
curl -s -N https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"aurora-streamtool-v1","input":"...","tools":[{"name":"llm_search","spec":"v1"}]}'
Diego: Any quotas changed?
Sylvia (product): No tier changes. New per-connection concurrent_streams default=10. We'll add to billing UI.
ops-bot: Canary deploy started in eu-central-1 (deploy id: canary-2061-eu). Status: in_progress.
eng-oncall: I'll monitor error-rate and latency for 6h. Please create a Datadog monitor: aurora.stream.p50 and aurora.stream.errors.rate.
Priya: Rollback criteria?
Matt R.: Auto-fallback to aurora-compat on >=5xx. Manual rollback if error rate >5% sustained 3m. Ops runbook updated.
Lina (docs): Deprecation: legacy toolcall model supported 90 days. I'll add migration scripts link.
Sylvia (product): External comms scheduled 09:00 PT tomorrow. Internal training session at 14:00 PT today.
Jen K.: Ping me for canary access. Thanks y'all! :rocket:
